items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Joe Avery. Joe Avery, yeah. He played a good while with us.

ctx.x: His name is a little, not French here. Joe Avery. Joe Avery, yeah. He played a good while with us. Joe Avery.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I know it wasn't Rob. It was a guy from Uptown. Oh, boy, that's something. Let me see, I really can't think of his name. A man from Uptown? Yeah, he was, I know, it was all about the name. Henry? No, it was, he's dead and gone. Is that name, we call it Joe Avery.

ctx.x: Two yards, you see, facing, as we come in on that street, hominist street, facing the club. Well, to your right of the building, I see the other day when we was up there, they had some houses given to them. Well, they had a yard on that side. And then, you know, to the left of the building, like this would be the front of the building, like this, this would be the right, like I'm facing you, and this would be the left.
